tools-tech.title: Word and Outlook will stop trying to guess what you’re going to type
tools-tech.excerpt: Microsoft’s text suggestion feature will now be turned off by default in both Word and Outlook, reports The Register. The text suggestions attempt to predict which words or phrases the user intends to
tools-tech.dwp_take: Microsoft is flipping text suggestions to off by default in Word and Outlook, letting users opt in instead of opt out. This matters because it finally acknowledges that forcing AI predictions on everyone regardless of workflow is annoying and productivity actually drops when software second-guesses what you're typing. After decades of watching Microsoft jam features nobody asked for into our faces, it's refreshing to see them actually listen, even if it took three decades to figure out that letting people choose their own experience is a novel concept.

industry-news.title: Kaseya announces new compliance and Apple device management tools for Datto RMM
industry-news.excerpt: The enhancements will introduce FIPS 140-3 validated cryptography and native Apple MDM to the remote monitoring and management platform
industry-news.dwp_take: Kaseya added FIPS 140-3 cryptography and native Apple device management to Datto RMM, which basically means the platform got more secure and finally stopped making Mac users feel like second-class citizens. For digital workplace folks managing mixed environments, this cuts down on the tool sprawl and compliance headaches that come with bolting together five different platforms. It's not revolutionary stuff, but in a world where people still ask me to manage iPhones through Windows-only software, sometimes competent execution feels like innovation.
